ModMetaData.name: Please use the pews ! (Ritual Seats Range Fix)
ModMetaData.author: Reqo
ModMetaData.description:
Allows you to configure the max distance (in tiles) at which pawns will look for seats for Rituals !
(Default settings is 50 tiles max, this can be changed in the settings!) ______________________________
Also allows you to force-enable the use of seats on rituals of your choice!
(Inside the settings as well ^v^)
Enjoy !
